question: For each instance on host blaze8-12, show the instance UUID and the total amount of migration memory processed (sum of MEMORY_PROCESSED) across its migrations, considering only instances whose total processed migration memory is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the overall mean MEMORY_PROCESSED across all migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH instance_migration_totals AS (
  SELECT
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed
  FROM instances AS i
  JOIN migrations AS m
    ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
  GROUP BY i.uuid
),
overall_migration_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(memory_processed) AS avg_memory_processed,
    STDDEV(memory_processed) AS stddev_memory_processed
  FROM migrations
)
SELECT
  imt.instance_uuid,
  imt.total_memory_processed
FROM instance_migration_totals AS imt
CROSS JOIN overall_migration_stats AS oms
WHERE imt.total_memory_processed > oms.avg_memory_processed + oms.stddev_memory_processed
